sample_unit: ED patients undergoing chest CT (228 pre, 252 post)
models_evaluated: AI-based natural language processing system for radiology reports

links.outcome: Patient notification and nodule-specific follow-up before vs after AI-supported outreach workflow
links.effect: Notification rose from 171/228 (75%) to 223/252 (88.4%), p = 0.0001; nodule-specific follow-up rose from 122/228 (53.5%) to 171/252 (67.9%), p = 0.0012.
links.quote: With implementation of the AI-supported workflow, patient notification increased from 171/228 (75%) to 223/252 (88.4%) p = 0.0001, and nodule-specific follow-up increased from 122/228 (53.5%) to 171/252 (67.9%) p = 0.0012.

unlisted_practices: AI-based NLP identification of incidental findings in radiology reports with proactive patient outreach to close follow-up gaps

screen.reason: The study evaluated the real-world pre-post deployment of an AI-based NLP system to flag incidental pulmonary nodules from radiology reports and facilitate proactive patient outreach/follow-up.

primary.practice: AI-supported tracking and patient outreach workflow
